title: 2020年9月四级真题 第1套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 Americans spend billions of dollars each year trying to change our weight with diets, gym memberships and plastic surgery.

P2 Trying to live up to the images of "perfect" models and movie heroes has a dark side: anxiety and depression, as well as unhealthy strategies for weight loss or muscle gain. It also has a financial cost. Having an eating disorder boosts annual health care costs by nearly US $2,000 per person.

P3 Why is there both external and internal pressure to look "perfect"? One reason is that society rewards people who are thin and healthy looking. Researchers have shown that body mass index is related to wages and income. Especially for women, there is a clear penalty at work for being overweight or obese. Some studies have also found an impact for men, though a less noticeable one.

P4 While the research literature is clear that labor market success is partly based on how employers and customers perceive your body image, no one had explored the other side of the question. Does a person's own perception of body image matter to earnings and other indicators of success in the workplace?

P5 Our recently published study answered this question by tracking a large national random sample of Americans over a critical time period when bodies change from teenage shape into adult form and when people build their identities.

P6 As in other research, women in our sample tend to over-perceive their weight—they think they're heavier than they are—while men tend to under-perceive theirs.

P7 We found no relationship between the average person's self-perception of weight and labor market outcomes, although self-perceived weight can influence self-esteem(自尊心), mental health and health behaviors.

P8 While the continued gender penalty in the labor market is frustrating, our finding that misperceived weight does not harm workers is more heartening.

P9 Since employers' perception of weight is what matters in the labor market, changing discrimination laws to include body type as a category would also help. Michigan is the only state that prohibits discrimination on the basis of weight and height. We believe expanding such protections would make the labor market more fair and efficient.

questions.q: What does the author say may have an adverse impact on people?
options: Undergoing plastic surgeries in pursuit of beauty.
Imitating the lifestyles of heroes and role models.
Striving to achieve perfection regardless of financial cost.
Attempting to meet society's expectation of appearance.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author say may have an adverse impact on people? 用 What 直 问作者所述的某种不利影响，是对原文事实信息的复述，不要求推理。

【拆句】What does the author say may have an adverse impact on people? 主干其实是 What may have an adverse impact on people（什么会对人产生不利影响），中间的 the author say 是插入说明「作者所说的」。考生若把 say 误当作主干动词，就会读不通；记 住「主语+情态动词 have+宾语」才是句子骨架。

【定位】Trying to live up to the images of "perfect" models and movie heroes has a dark side: anxiety and depression, as well as unhealthy strategies for weight loss or muscle gain. 努力达到「完美」模特和电影英雄的形象是有阴暗面的：焦虑、抑郁，以及不健康的减肥或 增肌方式。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 Undergoing plastic surgeries in pursuit of beauty（为了美而整形）只是 plastic surgery 在引子段被列举的现象之一，原文没说「整形」本身有 dark side，而是说「试 图迎合完美形象」才有。 B) 偷换概念 Imitating the lifestyles of heroes and role models 偷偷把原文的 images（形象、外 貌）替换成 lifestyles（生活方式），与原文 images of "perfect" models and movie heroes 强调的是「外貌形象」而非生活方式不符。 C) 无中生有 Striving to achieve perfection regardless of financial cost 的 regardless of financial cost（不计经济成本）在原文里没有依据；It also has a financial cost 只是说 「同时也产生经济成本」，并非「不计成本」。 D) ✓ 正确 Trying to live up to the images of "perfect" models and movie heroes ↔ Attempting to meet society's expectation of appearance Attempting to meet society's expectation of appearance 恰好把预判「迎合社会对 外貌期待」逐字呈现，正中。 研究人员对人们的收入有什么发现? A) 它们与人们的社会地位密切相关。 B) 它们与人们的体重和体型有关。 47. What have researchers found out about people's earnings? A) They are closely related to people's social status. B) They have to do with people's body weight and shape. C) They seem to matter much less to men than to women. D) They may not be equal to people's contributions. C) 它们对男性的重要性似乎远低于对女性的重要性。 D) 它们可能与人们的贡献不相称。

questions.q: What have researchers found out about people's earnings?
options: They are closely related to people's social status.
They have to do with people's body weight and shape.
They seem to matter much less to men than to women.
They may not be equal to people's contributions.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What have researchers found out about people's earnings? 问研究者「发现了什 么」，定位到结论句直接复述即可。

【拆句】What have researchers found out about people's earnings? 现在完成时强调「已经研 究并得出结论」，主干是 What have researchers found out（研究者发现了什么）， about people's earnings 是话题限定。结构平直，无陷阱。

【定位】Researchers have shown that body mass index is related to wages and income. 研究者已证明，身体质量指数（即体型胖瘦的衡量指标）与薪资和收入相关。

【选项】A) 无中生有 They are closely related to people's social status 的 social status（社会地位）在原 文从未出现，原文只谈体重/体型与收入的关系。 B) ✓ 正确 body mass index is related to wages and income ↔ They have to do with people's body weight and shape They have to do with people's body weight and shape 把定位句逐成分等值改写， 是与预判最贴合的一项。 C) 答非所问 They seem to matter much less to men than to women 把比较关系错置在「收入」 上，原文说的是「体重对女性收入的惩罚比男性明显」，而非「收入对男性意义更 小」。题目问的是研究者发现的关于收入的事，而非男女对收入的看重程度。 D) 无中生有 They may not be equal to people's contributions（收入可能与贡献不匹配）涉及的 「贡献」概念在原文完全不存在。 作者最近的研究关注什么? A) 关于职场竞争力指标的先前文献。 B) 在劳动力市场追求成功中最重要的特质。 C) 身体形象的自我认知是否影响职场成功。 D) 老板对身体形象的认知如何影响员工的晋升。

questions.q: What does the author's recent study focus on?
options: Previous literature on indicators of competitiveness in the workplace.
Traits that matter most in one's pursuit of success in the labor market.
Whether self-perception of body image impacts one's workplace success.
How bosses' perception of body image impacts employees' advancement.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author's recent study focus on? 直问研究焦点，需要在原文找到明 确指明研究问题的句子。 48. What does the author's recent study focus on? A) Previous literature on indicators of competitiveness in the workplace. B) Traits that matter most in one's pursuit of success in the labor market. C) Whether self-perception of body image impacts one's workplace success. D) How bosses' perception of body image impacts employees' advancement.

【拆句】What does the author's recent study focus on? 主干 What does the study focus on （研究关注什么），author's recent 是修饰 study 的两个前置定语。结构清晰，无难点。

【定位】Does a person's own perception of body image matter to earnings and other indicators of success in the workplace? Our recently published study answered this question by tracking a large national random sample of Americans over a critical time period when bodies change from teenage shape into adult form and when people build their identities. 一个人自己对身体形象的感知是否影响其收入和其他职场成功指标？我们最近发表的研究通 过追踪一批庞大的全国随机样本回答了这个问题——这些样本横跨人从青少年体型变成成年 体型、并开始建立自我认同的关键时期。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 Previous literature on indicators of competitiveness in the workplace 写的是「前 人文献」，但原文明确说「前人文献清楚雇主感知会影响职场成功，无人探究问题的另 一面」——前人文献是背景而非作者研究焦点。 B) 无中生有 Traits that matter most in one's pursuit of success in the labor market 的 Traits （特质）一词原文未出现；原文讨论的是「自我感知」这一具体维度，而非泛泛的 「特质」。 C) ✓ 正确 Does a person's own perception of body image matter to earnings and other indicators of success in the workplace? ↔Whether self-perception of body image impacts one's workplace success Whether self-perception of body image impacts one's workplace success 把 P4 的 疑问句逐成分改写，预判一对就中。 D) 与原文相反 How bosses' perception of body image impacts employees' advancement 的 bosses' perception（雇主的感知）恰恰是原文 how employers and customers perceive your body image 这条已被前人研究透、作者明确表态「另一面没人探讨」的 方向。作者研究焦点正是其对立面。 作者最近的研究有什么发现? A) 超重实际上对员工的整体福祉并没有太大损害。 B) 人们在职场中不会因对体重的错误自我认知而受到不利影响。 C) 自尊有助于对抗职场中的性别不平等。 D) 性别不平等继续使许多女性员工感到沮丧。 49. What is the finding of the author's recent research? A) Being overweight actually does not do much harm to the overall well-being of employees. B) People are not adversely affected in the workplace by false self-perception of body weight. C) Self-esteem helps to combat gender inequality in the workplace. D) Gender inequality continues to frustrate a lot of female employees.

questions.q: What is the finding of the author's recent research?
options: Being overweight actually does not do much harm to the overall well-being of employees.
People are not adversely affected in the workplace by false self-perception of body weight.
Self-esteem helps to combat gender inequality in the workplace.
Gender inequality continues to frustrate a lot of female employees.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What is the finding of the author's recent research? 问研究结论本身，是对原文 We found... 句的同义复述。

【拆句】What is the finding of the author's recent research? 主干 What is the finding（结果是 什么），of the author's recent research 是后置定语限定 finding 的来源。无难点。

【定位】We found no relationship between the average person's self-perception of weight and labor market outcomes, although self-perceived weight can influence self-esteem(自尊心), mental health and health behaviors. 我们发现普通人对自身体重的感知与劳动力市场结果之间没有关系，尽管自我感知的体重确 实会影响自尊心、心理健康和健康行为。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 Being overweight actually does not do much harm to the overall well-being of employees 把研究主语从「自我感知体重」换成「真实超重」；原文研究的是 self- perception（自我感知），不是 actual overweight；且原文从未说真实超重「不损 害」员工，P3 反而明确女性超重在职场上有 clear penalty。 B) ✓ 正确 no relationship between the average person's self-perception of weight and labor market outcomes ↔ People are not adversely affected in the workplace by false self-perception of body weight People are not adversely affected in the workplace by false self-perception of body weight 是对 P7 结论句的标准被动改写，与预判完全一致。 C) 与原文相反 Self-esteem helps to combat gender inequality in the workplace 说「自尊心帮助 对抗性别不平等」，与原文 self-perceived weight can influence self-esteem（自我 感知体重影响自尊）方向完全相反，且原文没说自尊能对抗性别不平等。 D) 答非所问 Gender inequality continues to frustrate a lot of female employees 对应的是 the continued gender penalty in the labor market is frustrating 那句情绪表态，并非作 者本次研究的核心发现；题干问 finding（研究结论），不是问情绪感受。 作者认为什么有助于改善劳动力市场的状况? A) 禁止基于员工身体形象的歧视。 B) 扩大对女性反性别歧视的保护。 50. What does the author think would help improve the condition in the labor market? A) Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image. B) Expanding protection of women against gender discrimination. C) Helping employees change their own perception of beauty. D) Excluding body shape as a category in the labor contract. C) 帮助员工改变自己对美的认知。 D) 在劳动合同中排除体型作为一个类别。

questions.q: What does the author think would help improve the condition in the labor market?
options: Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image.
Expanding protection of women against gender discrimination.
Helping employees change their own perception of beauty.
Excluding body shape as a category in the labor contract.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author think would help improve the condition in the labor market? 问作者认为什么能改善现状，对应原文末段的明确主张句。

【拆句】What does the author think would help improve the condition in the labor market? 主干 What would help improve the condition（什么能帮助改善现状），the author think 插入说明「作者认为」，in the labor market 限定改善对象。结构稍长但平直，提醒 考生把 the author think 当插入语处理即可。

【定位】Since employers' perception of weight is what matters in the labor market, changing discrimination laws to include body type as a category would also help. Michigan is the only state that prohibits discrimination on the basis of weight and height. We believe expanding such protections would make the labor market more fair and efficient. 既然在劳动力市场中真正起作用的是雇主对体重的感知，那么修改反歧视法、把体型也列入 受保护类别就会有所帮助。密歇根州是唯一以法律禁止基于体重和身高进行歧视的州。我们 相信扩大此类保护会让劳动力市场更公平、更高效。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 changing discrimination laws to include body type as a category ↔ Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image Michigan is the only state that prohibits discrimination on the basis of weight and height ↔ Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image Banning discrimination on the basis of employees' body image 把 P9 的法律建议 浓缩为一句，预判对比即中。 B) 偷换概念 Expanding protection of women against gender discrimination 把保护对象偷偷换 成「女性免受性别歧视」，但原文末段主张扩大的是「基于体型的反歧视保护」（body type），不是性别歧视保护；P8 提到 gender penalty 但作者紧接着说 our finding... is more heartening，并未把性别保护作为主推方案。 C) 与原文相反 Helping employees change their own perception of beauty 主张「帮助员工改变自 我审美感知」；但原文 Since employers' perception of weight is what matters in the labor market 明确表态「起作用的是雇主感知」，作者要改的是法律环境而不是员 工自我感知。 D) 与原文相反 Excluding body shape as a category in the labor contract 写的是「把体型排除在劳 动合同范畴之外」，与原文 include body type as a category 中 include（纳入）形成 Excluding（排除）的反义对立，完全反向。
